title: M7 building implementation — isolated packet
purpose: Implement all seven buildables and the battle Build menu without conflicting with other parallel changes.
task: Supply compile-oriented ZScript actors, handler method fragments, FL_T constants, T12 implementation fragments and precise operator hook instructions for complete §8.7 M7.

in: Build all 7 choices in exact spec order: sandbag, wire, mine, AT mine, MG nest (donor SM_MGTurret), ammo crate, aid station.

Implement crosshair LineTrace TRF_THRUACTORS max FL_T.BUILD_REACH, permitted ≤FL_T.BUILD_ZONE from US HQ spot 121 or US-held supply points; proper spawn at hit point, player angle; BuildCost skill/class reductions, atomic supply spend and spec refusal messages.
Build six FL_ actors in exclusively owned World.zs while preserving existing HQ/flag actors; mine/AT-mine trigger/damage and tick timings, wire slow/damage, HP/blocking, ammo/aid station cycles.

Author M7_FillBuildMenu and M7_ChooseBuild named methods; handler hook requests for menuId 2 in existing MenuChoose and RebuildMenu only, preserving B toggle, V selection and an open menu after placement.

Author T12 build args 0–6: placement existence, exact BuildCost supply decrement for each, hostile GER mine death ≤70 tics, MVP_ArmyTruck AT mine death ≤70 tics; one line FL_TEST PASS build / FAIL build with rationale within 1500 tics.
out: M8 progression/loot/camp UI, M9 audit, M10 packaging, tuning director, donor replacements, change to any existing test PASS criteria.

constraints: Use only the specifically supplied source files. source_001_FRONTLINE44_SPEC.md controls, including the approved §8.6 debut reservation. Distinguish verified source facts from untested engine hypotheses.

Parallel source authoring only; the operator alone integrates in M7→M8→M9→M10 order, repairs compiler/API faults, runs the engine, accepts milestones and ships. No engine is assumed available to this call; never claim that load or any test PASS was executed.

ZScript only for gameplay; all custom files under frontline/; no donor code modifications; FL_ custom class prefix and fl_ CVar prefix; every newly introduced production number other than 0/1 must be declared in FL_T. Do not weaken tests or change existing PASS semantics.

Preserve M0–M6 baselines and T1–T11/T13 arg0/T16; no whole-file Handler.zs, Tests.zs, Tuning.zs, zscript.zs, mapinfo.txt or keyconf.txt rewrites. A parallel implementation must provide method-only fragments and a machine-readable hooks.json for operator application.

Frozen-source status conflict: source_002 claims M6/T10 PASS while source_012 records T10 FAIL and source_016 was an unrun proposal. Treat current M6 verification as an operator preflight gate, not a proved PASS; never change director economics within this job.

Result is inert code; report unverified ZScript signature assumptions as PARTIAL/BLOCKED and provide diagnostics. Do not silently add game features, implement test-only cheats, relax thresholds or edit donor code.
Exclusive editable path: frontline/zscript/fl/World.zs ONLY; supply complete preserved-file replacement plus unified diff. Other gameplay output = fragments, never shared full files.
Use existing handler members menuId/cursor/menuItems/pointOwner/SpotPos/BattlePlayer/Say/AddInv and FL_Stats.BuildCost. Source Handler is not an editable output; additions are prefixed M7_.

Design hook records: Handler.MenuChoose new menuId==2 branch -> M7_ChooseBuild(cursor), Handler.RebuildMenu menuId==2 branch -> M7_FillBuildMenu(), Tests.WorldLoaded case 12 -> M7_SetupT12(), Tests.WorldTick case 12 -> M7_TickT12(). Existing NetworkProcess already processes B/V; do not add another override.
T12 tests must call the real production build action, not directly grant or destroy test actors to manufacture PASS; controlled setup/invulnerability may be used to isolate the checks.
